name: Exp_Dots
summary: This EA trades based on the custom 'Dots' indicator, which generates color-coded trend signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator switches from bearish to bullish color and sell positions when it switches from bullish to bearish color, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义'Dots'指标进行交易，该指标生成颜色编码的趋势信号。当指标从空头颜色切换为多头颜色时开多仓，从多头颜色切换为空头颜色时开空仓，并提供可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于自定义Dots指标的颜色变化来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标颜色数组Clr[1]从1变为0（即从空头转多头）时开多仓，当Clr[1]从0变为1（即从多头转空头）时开空仓。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈设置，同时在趋势反转时也会主动平仓（如多头信号出现时平空仓，空头信号出现时平多仓）。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于扣除浮亏后的可用保证金、基于扣除浮亏后的余额、以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认为0.1。策略使用SignalBar参数决定信号检测位置，默认为1即前一根已收盘K线，这是一种合理的做法以避免未收盘K线的信号反复。EA还实现了新K线检测机制IsNewBar()，避免在同一根K线上重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on color changes of the custom Dots indicator to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the indicator color array Clr[1] changes from 1 to 0 (bearish to bullish), and a sell position is opened when Clr[1] changes from 0 to 1 (bullish to bearish). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit settings in points, and the EA also actively closes opposite positions on trend reversal signals. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, free margin minus floating loss, balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default risk fraction of 0.1. The strategy uses the SignalBar parameter to determine which bar to check for signals, defaulting to 1 (the last closed bar), which is a sound practice to avoid repainting signals from unclosed bars. The EA implements a new bar detection mechanism via IsNewBar() to prevent duplicate trades on the same bar. Additionally, it includes a history loading mechanism LoadHistory() to ensure sufficient bar data is available before signal calculation.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式（可用保证金/余额/扣浮亏保证金/扣浮亏余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (free margin/balance/margin minus floating loss/balance minus floating loss/fixed lot)

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: 信号过滤器，限制最小波动幅度

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 指标计算所用价格类型

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description: 指标相对当前K线的偏移量

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于检测交易信号的K线索引
parameters.description_en: Bar index for trade signal detection

pros: 信号基于已收盘K线（SignalBar=1），避免未收盘K线信号反复跳动导致的虚假交易
支持五种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好的交易者
提供买卖开关独立控制，可以只做多或只做空，适应不同市场环境
新K线检测机制避免同根K线内重复开仓
止损止盈均有配置，默认风险回报比为1:2，较为合理
pros_en: Signals are based on closed bars (SignalBar=1), avoiding false trades from repainting signals on unclosed bars
Supports five money management modes, providing flexibility for traders with different risk preferences
Independent buy/sell switches allow directional-only trading to adapt to different market conditions
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate position opening within the same bar
Both stop loss and take profit are configurable, with a default risk-reward ratio of 1:2 which is reasonable
cons: 依赖自定义Dots指标，指标逻辑不透明，无法在代码中直接审查其核心算法
止损默认1000点、止盈2000点数值过大，对大多数品种而言可能不切实际
缺少点差过滤和交易时段过滤，在点差扩大或低流动性时段可能产生不利成交
没有追踪止损或移动止损功能，无法在趋势中锁定浮动利润
没有最大持仓数限制和账户整体风险控制，在连续亏损时缺乏保护机制
cons_en: Relies on the custom Dots indicator whose logic is opaque and cannot be audited directly in the EA code
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large for most instruments and may be impractical
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, which could lead to unfavorable fills during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
No trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits during trending moves
No maximum position limit or account-level risk control, lacking protection during consecutive losses
improvements: 添加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在高点差和低流动性时段交易
实现追踪止损功能，在趋势行情中动态锁定利润
增加最大同时持仓数和日/周最大亏损限制，强化账户级风险控制
将Dots指标逻辑内嵌或提供详细文档，使策略完全可审计
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid trading during high spread and low liquidity periods
Implement trailing stop functionality to dynamically lock in profits during trending markets
Add maximum concurrent position limit and daily/weekly max drawdown limits for stronger account-level risk control
Embed the Dots indicator logic or provide detailed documentation so the strategy is fully auditable

risk_points: 依赖外部自定义指标，指标逻辑不可审计，存在策略黑箱风险
默认止损止盈点数极大（1000/2000点），若在不合适的品种上运行可能导致巨大亏损
缺少点差过滤，在高点差时段入场可能显著降低策略盈利能力
没有账户级别的最大回撤或最大持仓保护机制
risk_points_en: Relies on external custom indicator with unauditable logic, creating black-box strategy risk
Default stop loss/take profit of 1000/2000 points is extremely large and could cause significant losses on unsuitable instruments
Lack of spread filter may significantly reduce strategy profitability during high-spread periods
No account-level maximum drawdown or maximum position protection mechanism
